paper.title: Revisiting the status quo bias: Replication of Samuelson and Zeckhauser (1988)

review.reason: Accepted revised reading-only scholarly reconstruction after provenance and locator fixes; reported contradictions and source limitations remain explicit.
checks: Inspected two phases (N=311 and N=316), hypothetical four-option scenarios, between-person framing within each repeated scenario, and weak wagon-color findings.

27 PDF text quotations matched their physical pages; seven table records now have physical-page locators. Independently rendered and visually checked pages 9, 10, 11 and 12 against every quoted White, investment, College C and wagon row, including exact p-values and confidence intervals.

Read archived original preregistrations for H1/H2, Phase 1 Word/QSF two-versus-four-scenario conflict, QSF2 QID56 choice 4, and preprint error documentation explaining missing 50/50 alternate cell. White-wagon and investment-scenario reporting discrepancies retained.
review.reviewScope: Independent public-Program and primary-paper review, with linked instrument claims checked against archived source files. No raw-data reproduction or protocol-fidelity attestation.
limitations: Web tool could not open external download endpoints; archived-source review does not certify present remote endpoint availability.
Xiao rendered tables are readable in the original PDF but cannot all be verified by the text-only automated quote extractor.
